justification: FreeRTOS task functions must terminate through vTaskDelete(NULL). This exception adds that call after async-context deinitialization in the shared example task.
limits: Only the exact modified file hash is approved; SDK and kernel sources remain unchanged.
Preserve task priorities, core counts, ticks, delays, work counters and GPIO timing.
Preserve the original firmware controls for all six board/configuration cases.
Positive acceptance requires actual main-task deletion and continued scheduling for at least eleven virtual seconds after deinitialization.
